# Brevlin S20 Portable Speaker: Setup Guide

Version 1.2. This guide applies to the Brevlin S20 portable Bluetooth speaker.

## 1. Introduction

Thank you for choosing the Brevlin S20. This guide explains how to unpack the speaker, charge it, pair it with a phone, laptop or tablet, and adjust the sound. Read the safety section before the first use and keep this guide together with your warranty card.

## 2. What is in the box

- One Brevlin S20 speaker
- One micro-USB charging cable, 60 cm long
- One quick start card
- One carrying strap

Check the contents of the box. If anything is missing or damaged, contact your retailer before you use the speaker.

## 3. Controls and ports

The top panel has four buttons: Power, Bluetooth, Volume up and Volume down. The Bluetooth button also answers and ends calls when the speaker is connected to a phone. The rear panel has the charging port and the auxiliary input. The status LED sits behind the front grille, under the logo.

## 4. Charging the speaker

Charge the speaker fully before the first use. Connect the micro-USB cable to the rear port and to a USB power adapter rated at 5 V. The status LED glows solid amber while the battery charges and turns off when the battery is full. A full charge takes about four hours.

Notes:

- Use only a 5 V adapter. A higher voltage can damage the charging circuit.
- Do not charge the speaker while the housing or the port is wet.
- Charging stops automatically at 100 percent. You do not need to unplug the speaker early.

## 5. Status LED

The LED shows the current state of the speaker:

- Flashes blue: the speaker is ready to pair with a device.
- Solid white: the speaker is connected to a device.
- Flashes red: the battery is low. Charge the speaker before you continue.
- Solid amber: the battery is charging.

## 6. Pairing with a device

1. Make sure the speaker is charged. Press the Power button to switch the speaker on.
2. Press and hold the Bluetooth button for 3 seconds, until the LED flashes blue.
3. On your phone or laptop, open the Bluetooth settings and select "Brevlin S20" from the list of devices.
4. Wait until the LED turns solid white. The speaker now plays audio from the device.

The speaker keeps up to 4 devices in its memory. When a fifth device pairs, the device that has been stored the longest is removed from the list. To pair a device that is already stored, select the speaker name on that device and confirm the connection.

Warning: Do not hold the Bluetooth button for longer than 5 seconds during pairing, because the speaker may switch to its standby mode and you must start again.

## 7. Specifications

| Specification | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Output power | 15 W RMS |
| Battery life | up to 12 hours at medium volume |
| Charging port | micro-USB |
| Bluetooth version | 5.0 |
| Paired devices in memory | up to 4 devices |
| Water resistance | IPX4, splash proof |
| Weight | 0.6 kg |
| Operating temperature | 0 °C to 40 °C |

The battery is built in. Battery life depends on the volume level, the audio content and the age of the battery.

## 8. Playing audio

Press Power to switch the speaker on. Start playback on your device. Use the Volume up and Volume down buttons on the speaker to change the level, or use the volume control on the connected device. The speaker switches to standby after 15 minutes without a connection or audio signal.

To use a wired source, connect a 3.5 mm cable to the auxiliary input on the rear panel. The speaker switches to the auxiliary input automatically when a cable is detected, and it returns to Bluetooth when the cable is removed.

## 9. Safety

- Do not expose the speaker to temperatures above 40 °C, for example inside a parked car in summer.
- Do not place the speaker on a heater or near an open flame.
- Do not open the housing. The battery is built in and must be replaced only by an authorised service centre.
- Do not submerge the speaker in water. The IPX4 rating protects against splashes only.

Warning: A swollen battery, a burning smell or leaking liquid means the speaker must be switched off and taken to a service centre at once.

## 10. Care and cleaning

Wipe the outside of the speaker with a soft, dry cloth. For stubborn marks, use a cloth that is slightly damp with water. Do not use solvents, alcohol or abrasive cleaners, because they can damage the grille and the coating. Keep the charging port dry and free of dust. Store the speaker in a cool, dry place when you do not use it for several weeks, and charge it to about half before storage.
